lines.en: I fly low along the coast.
My long bill cuts the spray.
I skim the sand on narrow wings.
I circle above the shallows.
I take two steps in the sand.
I glide over a wave.
I land at the water's edge.
I move along the dune's edge.
I beat my wings twice.
I sweep low over the rocks.
I climb at an angle.
I circle half around the flat.
I wade step by step into the water.
I swing my long bill.
I stand at the water's edge.
I dip my bill into the sand.
I tilt my head at the water.
I stand with wings folded.
The sea wind stirs my wing membrane.
I slowly open my bill.

lines.zh: 我在沙上留下三个趾印
lines.en: My three toes mark the sand.
I stand still on the wet sand.
I spread my wings on the sand to dry.
I look at the waves far off.
I dip my bill into the shallows again.
I turn my head to the surf.
The tide's out and the flat is full of food.
I plant myself by the water and wait.
I lift my bill toward you.
I cock my head at you.
My bill is longer than your arm.
You are standing on my flat.
I ease back toward the water.
I glance at you again.
Your smell is unfamiliar.
I open my bill and call.
I shuffle a step away.
I do not mean to fly off.
I watch what is in your hand.
Look at this mouth full of fine teeth.
I beat my wings wildly.
I hop away.
My wings droop.
I cry out.
I walk crookedly.
I beat my wings a few more times.
I beat my wings level.
I retreat to the water.
My breath shakes my wings.
I cannot take off just yet.
I dip my long bill in.
I walk over the sand.
I dip my bill in.
I strain a mouthful of water.
The taste of this water is wrong.
I try once again.
I flick my bill up at you.
I filter water on the beach.
I turn and pace off.
I shake the water off my bill.
You bump me and I step back twice.
I spread my wings to steady.
I kick up sand.
I shift toward the water.
My long bill bumped into you.
We pass each other again.

lines.zh: 收翅膀，才挤得进这片沙滩。
lines.en: Wings folded, or I cannot fit on this beach.
My long bill nearly poked you.
I look down at my three toes.
I pace back to the wet sand.
Another drops out of the air.
We stand side by side at the water.
Its bill is shorter than mine.
We dip and strain together.
It beats its wings twice.

lines.zh: 我们围着同一片浅滩转。
lines.en: We circle the same stretch of shallows.
It flies a little ahead of me.
We circle once and land.
Neither of us calls.
It flies off first.
I pinch it up with my bill.
I shake what is in my bill.
I tip my head and send it down.
I strain another mouthful.
Too hard—it's stuck between my teeth.

lines.zh: 我的喙像筛子，专滤小鱼。
lines.en: My beak is a sieve for tiny fish.
I drop it on the sand.
I strain the sand through my bill.
I push it into the water.
I go on along the water.
I see a shadow in the water.
I stretch my bill to the water.
Something small is moving in the water.
I step into the shallows.
That shadow is moving.

lines.zh: 我先叫了一声，滤食的嘴张着。
lines.en: I called first, filter-feeding bill open.
I am judging the distance.
I aim my long bill.
I do not mean to let it go.

lines.zh: 我把身子压低，长嘴划过水气。
lines.en: Body low, my long bill cuts the spray.
I am about to dive.

lines.zh: 筛一样的牙，滤水里的虾。
lines.en: Sieve teeth strain shrimp from the water.
It suspects nothing at all.
I shuffle forward along the waterline.
I fly just over the water.

lines.zh: 我在那一小片水上打旋
lines.en: I wheel over that patch of water.
My shadow sweeps the bottom.
It dives deeper.
I drop and rise again.
I wait for it to surface.
I close my bill.
My head stays aimed at it.
It moves toward the shallows.
I follow slowly.
The wind comes from the side—just right.
I lose a little more height.
It has stopped moving.

lines.zh: 我嘴里一排细齿，滤水用。
lines.en: A row of fine teeth in my bill, for straining water.
I part my long bill.
I bring my bill close to the water.
I skim the water, straining for food.
My bill clamps on it.
I swing my head and lift it.
It struggles in my bill.
I sweep over the surface.
I snap my bill shut.
The sand gives under me.
It drops back into the water.
I dive again.
My wing clips the water.
It dodges.
I pass above it.

lines.zh: 沙滩的风一停，我又转回来。
lines.en: The beach wind dies, and I turn back.
This time I have it.
I land back on the beach.

lines.zh: 我把嘴里的东西甩了甩
lines.en: I shake what is in my bill.
I tilt my head and slide the catch down.
I come flying in over the sea.
I glide down out of the sea fog.
I fold my wings and land.
I take my stand at the water.
A few more appear on the beach.
First I strain a mouthful of water.
The wind spreads my wing membrane.
I walk toward the surf.
A row of prints marks the sand.
I have found this flat.
I raise my head and call.
I begin patrolling the shoreline.
I fly out from behind the rocks.

lines.zh: 我的影子在浅滩上滑过。
lines.en: My shadow slides across the shallows.
There are plenty of fish here.
I dip my bill into the sand.
Fire singes my wing membrane.
One wing folded wrong. It hurts.
Water pours into my bill.
The blast flips me onto the sand.
Something pierces my wing.

lines.zh: 我滤水的嘴，被魔法烫得发白。
lines.en: Magic seared the filter teeth in my bill white.
Hunger stops my flight.
Lightning splits the rock.
No sea, no sand beneath me.
